sources.title: Control your dot
sources.supported_claim: Foreground pause, stopping a delegated task, and disabling a schedule are distinct controls. Inspect active tasks and schedules separately.
sources.scope: Documentation, not proof of this account's execution

sources.title: Tasks and memory
sources.supported_claim: Dots uses selected conversation context, relevant ChatGPT memory and its own saved notes. Background tasks can receive different context. A completed run does not itself establish that its requested result was achieved.
sources.scope: Motivates context limitations and artifact inspection; no inference about hidden implementation in these episodes

sources.title: TRACE: Governing Memory Validity in Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
sources.supported_claim: The paper studies whether previously valid information remains eligible for action after shared state changes, using returning-agent episodes.
sources.scope: Research motivation only. This Dots direct-update case study neither reproduces TRACE nor tests its algorithm or hidden memory mechanisms.
